results.title: Casablanca UHD Review - Home Theater Forum
results.snippet: First and foremost – would the theater be able to screen it in its original Academy aspect ratio (1.37:1) or be forced to crop to either 1.85:1 or worse, 2:1 (all but one screen at the complex had fixed 2:1 screens)? Luckily, Casablanca was projected and presented in its full 1.37:1 aspect ratio.
